name: Takasago (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Takasago city emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device of pointed strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Takasago, a city in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 December 1954.

features.role: Takasago city emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised device of pointed strokes
